summary: LGL Group filed an 8-K announcing an extension of its subscription rights offering expiration from June 23 to June 29, 2026. The rights offering allows holders of record to purchase one share of common stock per right at $6.90 per share, with an over-subscription privilege. No other terms changed. The filing is a standard administrative update to a capital-raising rights offering, not an event triggering special-situation analysis. The extension is likely due to logistical or participation matters. Watch for final subscription results and any potential under-subscription risk that could affect the capital raise.
